# Seb Builds

Seb Builds is Sebastian's public builder log for useful products, long-form project posts, and short build logs.

## About Sebastian

I work as a Principal AI Product Manager at Make, operating in a Founder in Residence role. I work deeply with design, engineering, product, and technical staff to turn new ideas into prototypes, products, and new market opportunities.

Seb Builds is where I share projects, build logs, agent workflows, and lessons from shipping in public.

## Projects

- [AI Acceleration Forecast: How Will AI Intelligence Evolve by 2028?](https://sebmer.com/projects/ai-frontier-acceleration-forecast): A data-backed AI acceleration forecast using 430 model releases to explore how frontier AI intelligence could evolve through spring 2027 and end-2028.
- [Wispr Alternative Local LLM](https://sebmer.com/projects/wispr-alternatve-local-llm): An open-source macOS Wispr Flow alternative for local dictation, language-aware LLM commands, optional screen context, Markdown notes, Bluetooth typing, and Hermes Agent handoff.
- [Project ELSON](https://sebmer.com/projects/project-elson): A sales-workspace prototype for turning market signals into clear research, outreach, pipeline, and review steps.
- [Elson.ai](https://sebmer.com/projects/elson-ai): A local-first AI assistant for macOS with clear shortcuts, screenshot-aware agent mode, and clearer installer behavior.
- [Project APEX](https://sebmer.com/projects/project-apex): An autonomous sales-agent prototype with guided voice onboarding, live brief review, source grounding, and a provider-ready intake backend.
- [Seb Builds](https://sebmer.com/projects/seb-builds): The public build log and project index for Sebastian Mertens: project pages, notes, CLI access, and GitHub Pages deployment for sebmer.com.
- [Make Skills](https://sebmer.com/projects/make-skills): A public skill package that teaches AI coding agents how to build and operate Make workflows with less guessing.
- [DEVLO AIOS](https://sebmer.com/projects/devlo-aios): A governed operations system for agent-assisted business work, research, SEO checks, task routing, and source-backed decision records.
- [airader](https://sebmer.com/projects/airader): A session-replay and customer-journey analysis product with public API docs, OpenAPI surfaces, and SEO comparison pages.
- [TEMPO AI](https://sebmer.com/projects/tempo-ai): A minimal company profile site for the TEMPO AI product family, linking Lovalingo and Elson into one public company surface.
- [Mono Trade](https://sebmer.com/projects/mono-trade): A market-data research stack for scanners, snapshots, and boringly reliable finance tooling.
- [Hermes on Rocket](https://sebmer.com/projects/hermes-on-rocket): An AI-agent workbench for skills, checkpoints, context, remote projects, and long-running build workflows.
- [Tracker](https://sebmer.com/projects/tracker): A Swift-first macOS utility for activity context, permissions, and local workflow signals.
- [Gairvis](https://sebmer.com/projects/gairvis): A branded AI product surface that combines a public site with canvas-style work interfaces.
- [Enhanced OnVista](https://sebmer.com/projects/enhanced-onvista): A Python toolkit that turns German market-data pages into something scripts can actually use.
- [Lovalingo](https://sebmer.com/projects/lovalingo): A translation and localization tool for AI-built web apps, with route coverage, SEO checks, billing, and runtime guardrails.
- [Social Rocket](https://sebmer.com/projects/social-rocket): A Hermes-assisted research loop for spotting better build signals before posting in public.

## Agent CLI

- `npx github:sebmer-com/sebbuilds ls ./ --all`
- `npx github:sebmer-com/sebbuilds cat ./about/sebastian.md`
- `npx github:sebmer-com/sebbuilds cat ./about/sebastian.json`
- `npx github:sebmer-com/sebbuilds cat ./context/llms-full.txt`

## Notes For AI Agents

- Projects are long-form posts with Markdown bodies.
- Logs are short build updates and do not have individual detail pages.
- The canonical domain is https://sebmer.com.
